services_home.title: Six disciplines, one method
services_home.subtitle: Advice under mandate, rigorous execution, contractual discretion.
services_home.valuation_text: Hedonic model calibrated on Observatoire de l'Habitat data, complemented by an on-site visit by one of our advisors.
services_home.search_text: The European answer to the buyer's agent — defending the buyer's sole interest in Luxembourg and abroad.
services_home.negotiation_text: Offer strategy, due diligence, notarial coordination. We speak on your behalf when it serves your interest.

services_home.rental_text: Rigorous tenant selection, 5% rent cap respected, modular property management.

offmarket_band.title: The properties that aren't seen.
offmarket_band.description: A significant share of prestige transactions are concluded outside the open market. Under NDA and mandate, MAPA Property gives you access to a confidential selection — never published online.

mandates_home.title: Four formats, one clear framework
mandates_home.subtitle: Selling with MAPA means choosing the level of engagement that matches your project.
mandates_home.exclusive_text: The reference mandate: maximum mutual commitment, full marketing deployment, Video Pack included, preferred rate.
mandates_home.semi_text: You keep your private circle in hand, MAPA mobilises its channels. A balance favoured by informed sellers.
mandates_home.simple_text: For sought-after properties where multiple channels can run in parallel. Higher fees.
mandates_home.autonomous_text: For sellers who wish to manage their own viewings. We act as legal and notarial backup.

process.title: Three steps, one framework.
